summary: Tested new change-password feature (backend + frontend). All 8 backend pytest cases pass (login, unauth 401, wrong current 400, non-6-digit 400, new==current 400, valid change + re-login, seed_admin does not reset admin password after backend restart, kasir change-password flow with cleanup). Frontend flows verified: admin sidebar user menu opens ChangePasswordDialog; submit disabled until 6-digit + match; mismatch shows password-mismatch; wrong current triggers error toast; valid change closes dialog; re-login with new sandi works; admin sandi restored to 123456. Kasir header btn-change-password-kasir opens and closes the same dialog. Admin password has been restored to 123456 as required.

issues: Header brand says 'VoucherKu' while AdminLayout brand says 'Voucher88' - inconsistent branding.
Header is crowded on desktop: Logout text + KeyRound icon + sound icon sit tightly; consider grouping via a dropdown menu similar to admin.

action_items: (optional) Align kasir header brand name to 'Voucher88' to match AdminLayout.

(optional) Consider tightening pytest-xdist test isolation: current admin-password tests race across workers; addressed by module-scoped restore fixture but running via `-o addopts=` (single worker) recommended for this file.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_admin now correctly skips resetting existing admin password - verified via restart test.
change_password checks current password before checking new==current; behavior is correct per spec.
ChangePasswordDialog: uses credentials:'include' with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL - correct.
Minor: server.py is ~830 lines; consider splitting auth/voucher/settings routers into separate modules for maintainability.
